title: Frappe ERPNext 13.0.0 before 15.124.2 and 16.x before 16.53.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a…
description: Frappe ERPNext versions 13.0.0 before 15.124.2 and 16.x before 16.53.0 have a missing authorization vulnerability in a Stock module endpoint. This flaw allows authenticated users, including those with limited access such as portal users or users restricted to certain warehouses, to retrieve sensitive item cost data without proper permission checks. The exposed data includes valuation rates and average purchase costs for items, companies, or warehouses outside their authorized scope.
